We sought to determine whether body mass index (BMI) differentially modified the effect of transplant procedure type on 90-day mortality in IPF patients. Meanwhile, none of selected AQP3 polymorphisms were related to AQP3 expression in tumor tissue or survival in the current study.", "Previous muscle activity can alter muscle contractility and lead to strength underestimation or overestimation in functional measurements.
